name: midl3-language-server
description: Full-featured IDE for WinRT Interface Definition Language — real-time diagnostics, smart autocomplete, go-to-definition, code actions, WinMD output, and more.

midl.serverPath.description: Path to the MIDL CLI executable for the language server.

midl.strictMode.description: Enable strict MIDL3 mode. When enabled, classic MIDL constructs (coclass, library, typedef, etc.) produce warnings. Disable for mixed MIDL2/MIDL3 codebases.

midl.codeQualityHints.description: Show code quality hints (naming conventions, empty types, etc.)

midl.useWindowsSdk.description: Automatically reference Windows.winmd from the installed Windows SDK for type completion and F12 navigation.

midl.reportSystemImportDiagnostics.description: Report diagnostics for IDL files imported from the Windows SDK. Those files are classic MIDL2 and produce thousands of strict-mode errors you cannot act on, so they are suppressed by default. Diagnostics for your own imported files are always reported.

midl.windowsSdkVersion.markdownDescription: Windows SDK version to use. Use the **MIDL: Select Windows SDK Version** command to pick from installed versions.

midl.flatSdkTypeCompletions.description: Show all SDK types by short name in completions (e.g. 'Button', 'Control'). When off, only SDK namespace names appear and you drill in with dot notation.

midl.inlineDocsBrowser.description: Open Microsoft Learn documentation in a VS Code side panel instead of the external browser.

midl.arrays.description: Enable array parameter syntax (T[]) in MIDL3. When enabled, parameters and return types can use T[] for WinRT array passing conventions.

midl.defines.description: Preprocessor defines for IDL compilation. Content inside #ifdef blocks for undefined symbols will be grayed out.
